name: Sylphis Castries
original_name: シルフィス・カストリーズ
source:
Star Sign: Gemini
Hobby: Exercising
Special Skill: Fast Legs
Likes: Quiet Places, Flowers
Dislikes: Crowds
Treasure: A Fountain Pen got from Elder

A youth of the special Anhel tribe that chooses their gender around the age of 13. But for some reason Sylphis still hasn't chosen yet and their gender is undecided.
While being worried about that they are still aiming to become a knight and are working hard as an apprentice.
A reserved person who doesn't talk much.

[A capturable character when playing as the other protagonists, their gender changes to male then.]
